title: Working with strings
description:
Complete the methods:

```java
static String initials(String fullName)                 // "ada king lovelace" gives "A.K.L."
static int countWord(String text, String word)          // whole-word matches, ignoring case
static String censor(String text, String word)          // every match of word (ignoring case) replaced by * of the same length
static String priceLine(String item, double price)      // item left in 12 characters, price right in 8 with 2 decimals
```

- `initials` ignores extra spaces.
- `countWord("The cat and the hat. THE end", "the")` is 3: words are separated by anything that is not a letter.
- `censor("Darn, DARN it", "darn")` gives `"****, **** it"`; it replaces inside words too (`"darned"` becomes `"****ed"`).
- `priceLine("Tea", 2.5)` is `"Tea             2.50"`. Use `String.format(Locale.ROOT, ...)` so the decimal point is `.` everywhere.
hints: `text.split("\\s+")` splits on runs of white space; `split("[^\\p{L}]+")` splits on runs of anything that is not a letter.
For `censor`, search in the lower-cased text, but change the characters in a `StringBuilder` made from the original, so the rest keeps its case.
